title: track.add
description: Shows count more track slots after the visible ones (default 1), as the + button of OpenTune's track panel does. If fewer hidden slots remain, the call fails with INVALID_ARGUMENT(track_limit) and shows none. changes lists every track that became visible (member visible), and visibleTrackCount gives the number of visible tracks before and after. A shown track keeps the clips it holds, as a later track can after a project was opened. OpenTune saves the number of visible tracks with the project, so the call marks the project as changed (dirty.after is true), as the + button does. The + button has no undo in OpenTune and no request restores the previous number, so undo is {undoable: false, reason: no_upstream_undo, revert: null} and the result carries the warning IRREVERSIBLE (subject the first track shown; PROTOCOL.md section 15.2 rule 2). track.delete can remove a track that was shown, but it is no revert recipe: it deletes the clips on the track with it, one request deletes one track, so it cannot take back several shown tracks, and it needs the end user's consent.
